summary: Iteration 6 covers the user-profile / doctor-limits / personal_tier softening / AI patient-context feature. Backend: 16/16 new pytest passing (/app/backend/tests/test_profile_ai_context.py, JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_profile_ai_context.xml). Frontend: onboarding 3-step flow, food detail personalized-note, Settings health profile, and Ask AI (English + Hindi) all verified on the preview URL at 375x667. Backend verifications: (1) GET /api/auth/me returns diabetic=false and doctor_limits=null for a fresh user, plus stage='unknown'. (2) PATCH /api/auth/profile — 401 without token, {diabetic:true} persists and is reflected by /me, partial doctor_limits={K:1800,Na:1500} stores and phosphorus/fluid remain null, empty patch {} returns UserOut unchanged, {doctor_limits:{}} clears all limits back to null. (3) /api/meal-logs/summary + /api/reports/weekly honour doctor_limits — setting only K=1800 on a dialysis user yields limits={K:1800,P:1000,Na:2000} in both endpoints; clearing reverts to stage defaults; pre_dialysis defaults confirmed as {K:2400,P:1200,Na:2300}. (4) personal_tier logic — dialysis+food-atta-roti (YELLOW/PHOSPHORUS) → RED; pre_dialysis+food-toor-dal (YELLOW/POTASSIUM) → GREEN with personalized_note starting 'Often fine before dialysis' (KDOQI 2020); pre_dialysis+food-idli (YELLOW/SODIUM) → YELLOW & note null; pre_dialysis+food-atta-roti (YELLOW/PHOSPHORUS) → YELLOW never softened; unknown+food-toor-dal → YELLOW & note null. (5) Ask AI — lang='en' returns English (0 Devanagari), lang='hi' returns >=20 Devanagari chars containing common Hindi words (है/हैं/नहीं/etc.), zero-meal-log user still succeeds (patient-context builds cleanly), 200 in every case. Frontend verifications: (a) Registered fresh TEST_ pre_dialysis user, accepted disclaimer, Step 1 shows stage-pre-dialysis/stage-dialysis + onboarding-continue; Step 2 shows diabetic-yes/diabetic-no + onboarding-back + diabetic-continue and onboarding-back correctly returns to Step 1 (stage pills re-appear); Step 3 shows limit-potassium/limit-phosphorus/limit-sodium + limits-save + limits-skip (also a limits-back extra button). Both limits-save (1800/900/1500) and limits-skip completed and landed on the tabbed home (food-list rendered). (b) /food/food-toor-dal for pre_dialysis user renders personalized-note card with copy 'Often fine before dialysis — confirm your serum potassium with your doctor. Portion sizes and lab values matter more than a blanket \'yellow\' at this stage (KDOQI 2020).' and safety-badge is GREEN (softened correctly). (c) /food/food-idli for pre_dialysis user does NOT render personalized-note (sodium not softened) — verified via DOM testid enumeration. Also re-verified /food/food-idli after switching demo user to dialysis: still no personalized-note. (d) /settings — settings-stage, settings-stage-pre-dialysis, settings-stage-dialysis, settings-diabetic-toggle, settings-limits-default, settings-limit-potassium, settings-limit-phosphorus, settings-limit-sodium, settings-save-limits, lang-en, lang-hi, signout-button, review-disclaimer-button all present. Switched stage to dialysis, toggled diabetic, saved partial limits {K:1700,P:800} — button clicks succeed (settings-clear-limits testid appears only after limits are set). Note: settings-clear-limits is dynamically rendered — the settings-limits-default pill re-appears once the doctor_limits object is cleared. (e) Ask AI (English UI, demo user on dialysis): 'Is lauki safe?' returned a plain-English answer (0 Devanagari chars). (f) Switched language to Hindi via lang-hi in Settings, resent same question — screenshot conclusively shows Hindi Devanagari response ('यह kidney के लिए बहुत अच्छी सब्ज़ी है क्योंकि इसमें potassium और phosphorus कम होते हैं...'), keeping English food/nutrient names in brackets as instructed by the system prompt. Regression: prior iteration-5 pytest (test_nutrient_budget.py) now has 3 failures — TestMealLogSummary::test_empty_summary_defaults, test_summary_totals_after_logging, and TestWeeklyAvgDaily::test_weekly_empty_has_avg_and_limits — but these are EXPECTED regressions: they asserted stage-default limits of {K:2000,P:1000,Na:2000} for a fresh (unknown-stage) user, but the new spec explicitly loosens unknown/pre_dialysis to {K:2400,P:1200,Na:2300}. Not a bug — main agent should update those 3 assertions to match the new defaults. Existing test_new_features.py runs hit /register rate limits (5/min per IP) after the two heavy iteration-6 test runs; the failures are all 429 noise (not real regressions). No red-screen errors, no deprecated packages surfaced (checked expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch — none imported).

ui_bugs.issue: Under the safety badge for a pre_dialysis user viewing a softened food (e.g. food-toor-dal), the label reads 'Personalized for dialysis stage' — copy is misleading because the user is pre-dialysis, not dialysis. The GREEN badge and personalized-note copy are correct; only the sub-label wording is off. Reference: /app/frontend/app/food/[id].tsx (search for 'Personalized for' string).

action_items: OPTIONAL: In /app/frontend/app/food/[id].tsx, change the static 'Personalized for dialysis stage' sub-label to read 'Personalized for your CKD stage' (or interpolate the user's stage) so pre_dialysis users don't see 'dialysis stage' wording.

OPTIONAL: Update /app/backend/tests/test_nutrient_budget.py 3 tests to match new stage-based defaults for unknown/pre_dialysis users (K:2400, P:1200, Na:2300) instead of the old hardcoded {K:2000,P:1000,Na:2000}. Alternatively, seed those tests with an explicit `POST /api/auth/stage {stage:'dialysis'}` to keep the old assertions valid.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py personal_tier_for + personalized_note_for are pure functions and correctly gate softening on YELLOW + POTASSIUM only for pre_dialysis; sodium/phosphorus are never softened, matching KDOQI 2020 guidance in the note text.

backend/server.py limits_for_user prefers doctor_limits values only when truthy (uses `doc.get(k) or defaults[k]`) — this means a doctor could NOT explicitly set 0 mg (edge case). If a doctor ever wanted a zero limit (unlikely for these fields) it would silently fall through to defaults. Minor and probably intentional.

backend/server.py PATCH /auth/profile treats `doctor_limits: null` in the JSON body as 'no-op' (because ProfileUpdate.doctor_limits Optional[DoctorLimits]=None), while `doctor_limits: {}` (or any object where all four fields are null/absent) clears the limits. The spec says `{doctor_limits:null}` should also clear — currently only empty-object clears. Minor spec drift worth flagging (frontend appears to send `{doctor_limits: null}` from Settings clear button; verify main agent aligns backend to accept both or frontend sends `{}`).

backend/server.py _build_ai_context correctly guards zero-meal-log case (`if logs:` branch skipped) and always builds the PATIENT CONTEXT block with limits+stage+diabetic. Hindi instruction is appended only when lang=='hi'. Session id includes lang so English/Hindi conversations don't share context.
frontend/app/onboarding.tsx: back button on Step 2 works; Step 3 has both save and skip paths + an extra 'limits-back' testid (undocumented but harmless).
frontend/app/food/[id].tsx: personalized-note testid is correctly gated on `food.personalized_note` presence — sodium/phosphorus items never render it.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (onboarding 3-step incl. back; toor-dal personalized-note present for pre_dialysis; idli no-note for pre_dialysis and dialysis; Settings health-profile testIDs all present + stage/diabetic/limits save works; Ask AI English + Hindi answer verified via UI screenshot)

seed_data_creation: Registered multiple fresh TEST_<uuid>@renal.app users (pre_dialysis / dialysis / unknown stages) for tier/note/limits testing. Demo user (demo@renal.app) state: after test — stage=dialysis, diabetic toggled during Settings test, doctor_limits temporarily {K:1700,P:800} during Settings test (then user did not click clear, so may still be set — flag for main agent to reset demo user limits if pristine state is needed). Language reset to English at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) Register rate limit is 5/min per IP — heavy test runs will trigger 429s on /api/auth/register; either sleep 65s between runs or use module-scoped fixtures that share tokens. 2) EXPO_BACKEND_URL is not in frontend/.env under that key — the actual key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Use https://kidney-safe-swap.preview.emergentagent.com directly or export EXPO_BACKEND_URL manually before pytest. 3) The Ask AI screen renders all messages inside a single [data-testid='ai-messages'] container — innerText truncated at ~500 chars gives you only the latest message; use querySelectorAll('[data-testid="ai-msg-ai"]') to pull individual bot messages (ai-msg-ai is the AI bubble testid). 4) In Settings, settings-clear-limits testid is DYNAMICALLY rendered only when doctor_limits is non-null; when limits are default, only settings-limits-default pill is visible. 5) Onboarding Step 3 has an extra 'limits-back' testid (return to Step 2) — undocumented in the spec but harmless.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects in the new feature. Two minor observations documented in action_items: (a) 'Personalized for dialysis stage' static copy under the food-detail safety badge is misleading for pre_dialysis users (cosmetic only); (b) PATCH /auth/profile treats `{doctor_limits: null}` as no-op — clearing requires `{doctor_limits: {}}` — potential spec drift worth confirming with the frontend Settings clear button payload.
